title: say hello to CHEESE
body:
![portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/121a2f3baa27c040a19aa911746c8cdf501e715c.png)

Steve has finally figured out how to turn milk into cheese!
but one day a mysterious man showed up to him ...
he found a nether portal in steve's base.
this man decided do give steve an offer.
steve agreed to have the obsidian replaced with cheese.
he jumps in the portal,
and finds a world full of **CHEESE**


way better than mojangs cheese dimension!

hope you guys enjoy!
